positions.subject: q:housing/citywide-rezoning
positions.summary: Voted yes on the Family Zoning Plan zoning map ordinance (File No. 250700) on first reading on December 2, 2025 and at final passage on December 9, 2025; in his GrowSF questionnaire he says the plan struck a good balance.

citations.quote: Ayes: 7 - Dorsey, Mahmood, Mandelman, Melgar, Sauter, Sherrill and Wong
citations.locator: p. 72, legislative history, December 02, 2025, passed on first reading

citations.quote: Ayes: 6 - Dorsey, Mahmood, Mandelman, Melgar, Sauter and Sherrill
citations.locator: p. 72, legislative history, December 09, 2025, final passage

citations.quote: The Family Zoning Plan struck a good balance, but there’s always more that can be done when it comes to housing.
citations.locator: Housing: Do you think Mayor Lurie’s Family zoning plan is too ambitious or not ambitious enough?
